source: Create a social hangout house with private bedrooms and locked bathrooms where two players can be alone together.

image_prompt.text: The central common area of the house, the shared space the private rooms open off
Detailed corners of the common area built as backdrops for roleplay scenes
A distinct feature of the house readable from a distance
The house itself, entered from outside, with the interior as the whole play space
Private bedrooms off the common area, each closable
Bathrooms that lock, attached to the private rooms

notes: Shape forced. Every housing model in this genre is a settlement of several houses; the prompt is one house whose interior is the entire map. settlement-static is the closest because nothing is player-built or claimed, but it describes a town.
landmark-focal is carried from the preset and fights the prompt - see preset_rejected.
Locking is the load-bearing request here and it is a door property, not geometry. Nothing in the option table expresses an access rule on a door.

open_questions.ask: Modern suburban, cosy cabin, something else?
How many bedrooms - two, or a houseful?
Can bedroom doors lock as well, or only the bathrooms?

coverage_missing.ask: What style of house - modern suburban, cosy cabin, something else?
Is the house alone on the map, or does it sit in a neighbourhood?

answers.ask: Modern suburban, cosy cabin, something else?
answers.answer: Use a modern suburban social hangout house.

answers.ask: How many bedrooms - two, or a houseful?
answers.answer: Use two private bedrooms to keep the house small and plainly playable.

answers.ask: Can bedroom doors lock as well, or only the bathrooms?
answers.answer: Bedroom doors can lock as well as the bathrooms, so two players can have privacy in either space.
